title: Bitcoin miner Riot could pay Anthropic 12% interest under $28 billion AI deal
reason: Major $28 billion AI-Bitcoin crossover deal between two named companies with material financing details.

sources.summary: Riot has sold most of its bitcoin to fund its move into data centers. Its latest agreement gives Anthropic a way to finance part of the build and collect interest through rent deductions.

title: OpenAI says its AI can break into Linux at scale. Here's what it means for crypto
reason: Frontier lab capability claim with concrete figures (948 flaws, working exploits) that shifts the AI security landscape.

sources.summary: OpenAI says its AI found 948 Linux flaws and wrote a working attack for each one. Crypto security voices say decentralization leaves the industry better placed than most to cope.
